nina: Heads-up from a customer repro today — the KB article on prompt-evals returns a stale snippet and the inline search snippet preview shows an old response example. The link is /handbook/quality/prompt-evals and the inline embed example still shows the legacy `eval_score` field.

odell: can you paste the snippet you saw?

nina: sure — code block on the page has:```json
{"prompt_id":"1234","eval_score":0.92,"notes":"good"}
```
We now use `score.value` and `score.metadata` in the JSON. Also the search preview (the small snippet in the internal search UI) surfaces the old field which confuses SEs during oncalls.

karim: I can update the KB page to the new shape and push a tiny migration note. We should also update the search index doc preview so the UI reflects the new JSON example.

nina: thanks. @docs-owners can we assign an owner for that KB page? it's currently owner: none in frontmatter.

docs-owners: assigning @platform-knowledge (karim) as owner. Please add frontmatter and a short changelog entry.

karim: plan: 1) edit /handbook/quality/prompt-evals.md to use `score.value`/`score.metadata`, 2) add a migration note section for older evals, 3) update the internal search preview mapping (search:docs-previews) and 4) add a CI smokecheck that validates the rendered example JSON exists in the generated HTML. I'll open one PR covering the doc and the preview mapping.

odell: for the search mapping, let's keep a compatibility transform that maps `eval_score` -> `score.value` for one month so historical entries still surface a sensible preview. I'll file an infra ticket for the transform TTL.

ci-bot: CI queued by karim at 2025-06-18T09:02:10Z  docs-build #3207

karim: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1533 "kb: prompt-evals - update example shape, add migration note, update search preview mapping". I included a one-liner smokecheck (`curl -sS staging/docs/handbook/quality/prompt-evals | grep 'score.value'`) in the CI steps.

ci-bot: docs-build #3207 completed at 2025-06-18T09:05:02Z  smokecheck OK (example contains score.value)

search-bot: Search index update queued: docs-previews mapping will apply compatibility transform for 30 days (ticket INFRA-834).

nina: validated staging: page shows `{"prompt_id":"1234","score": {"value":0.92,"metadata":"good"}}` and the migration note is clear. The internal search preview now truncates correctly and no longer references eval_score.

odell: LGTM. karim please add a short note in the release changelog under "Docs" and mark the KB owner in frontmatter.

karim: done — changelog entry and frontmatter owner added. Merging after one more docs-owners ack.

docs-owners: acked, go ahead and merge.

nina: thanks team! small follow-up: can we add a lint warning for deprecated `eval_score` references so we catch future regressions?

karim: added DOCS-241 to backlog for a doc-lint rule to warn on `eval_score`.

ci-bot: Merge completed and staging deploy queued at 2025-06-18T09:08:10Z  build 9021

search-bot: Compatibility transform scheduled; will revert mapping after 30 days unless INFRA ticket updated.

nina: confirmed fix in production after merge. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
